sentiment: The quiet math of reaching others is the longest proof we ever write.

stories.title: Claude Opus 5
stories.summary: Anthropic's most capable model yet lands with 1500+ points on HN — another step in the long arc of machines learning to think alongside us.

stories.title: Hannah Fry Wins the Leelavati Prize in 2026 for Mathematics Outreach
stories.summary: The Leelavati Prize honors Fry for making mathematics feel alive and accessible — proof that the deepest ideas travel farthest when someone cares enough to translate them.

stories.title: Android May Soon Restrict On-Device ADB
stories.summary: Google tightening on-device ADB access is a quiet reminder that the tools we build to reach into machines can always be pulled back.
